name: WAVESURFER
author: amnmkkr
description: Bastl Instruments' Kastle 2 Wave Bard (MIT) as a sample player over the project's pool: banks of pool rows, pitch from the trig's note with Wave Bard's quantizer, length forward and reversed, a start point for vocal chops, its tempo-synced delay, chorus and DJ filter. Wave Bard's own code runs unchanged at 44 kHz.
